stories.title: Green Onions
stories.reason: The band recorded its organ-led instrumental in the former theater on this block.

stories.place: Standin’ on the Corner Park, Winslow
stories.title: Take It Easy
stories.reason: Winslow built this downtown corner park around the town’s appearance in the song.

stories.title: All You Need Is Love
stories.reason: The Beatles performed this song here for the 1967 Our World satellite broadcast.
